data.outcome_summary: This OECD Survey of Adult Skills 2023 country note reports proficiency outcomes for adults aged 16–65 in the Flemish Region (Belgium) in the 2022–23 cycle, with comparisons to the first participation cycle (2011–12). The assessment covers three domains—literacy, numeracy, and adaptive problem solving—administered exclusively on digital tablets, and proficiency is reported on 500-point scales with discrete proficiency levels. The note provides mean performance estimates and the distribution across levels (e.g., shares at Level 1 or below and Levels 4–5), alongside 95% confidence intervals. It also summarises subgroup patterns (e.g., age differences, educational attainment gradients, and immigrant-background gaps) and associations between numeracy proficiency and labour-market and well-being/civic outcomes, including adjusted relationships. The note does not present an ML modelling approach, PV estimation procedure, or explicit missing-data handling strategy in the provided text.
